description: This file implements a driver for DES encryption using the Linux kernel crypto API, including functions for setting keys, processing encryption/decryption requests, and managing hardware interaction for DES and 3DES algorithms within the DEU module.

methods.name: lq_des_setkey
methods.description: Sets the DES key in the crypto context.

methods.name: lq_des3_ede_setkey
methods.description: Sets the 3DES EDE key in the crypto context.

methods.name: lq_deu_des_core
methods.description: Main interface to DES hardware for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: count_sgs
methods.description: Counts the number of scatterlist segments for a total byte size.

methods.name: des_container_cast
methods.description: Casts an ablkcipher_request to des_container structure.

methods.name: lq_sg_complete
methods.description: Frees memory after encryption/decryption completes.

methods.name: lq_sg_init
methods.description: Initializes scatterlist buffers for processing.

methods.name: process_next_packet
methods.description: Processes the next packet in the encryption/decryption queue.

methods.name: process_queue
methods.description: Handles processing of queued DES requests.

methods.name: des_crypto_thread
methods.description: Kernel thread managing DES crypto requests and DMA.

methods.name: lq_queue_mgr
methods.description: Queues DES requests for processing.

methods.name: lq_des_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using DES.

methods.name: lq_des_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using DES.

methods.name: lq_ecb_des_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data in ECB mode using DES.

methods.name: lq_ecb_des_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data in ECB mode using DES.

methods.name: lq_cbc_des_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data in CBC mode using DES.

methods.name: lq_cbc_des_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data in CBC mode using DES.

methods.name: lq_des_alg
methods.description: Structure representing DES crypto algorithms.

methods.name: lqdeu_async_des_init
methods.description: Initializes the DES driver and registers algorithms.

methods.name: lqdeu_fini_async_des
methods.description: Unregisters the DES algorithms and cleans up.
